# Airport Bansko Transfer

> Private, fixed-price airport transfer service between Sofia and Plovdiv airports (Bulgaria), Thessaloniki and Kavala airports (Greece) and the Bansko area (Bansko, Razlog, Dobrinishte, Pirin Golf) in Bulgaria's Pirin mountains. Based in Bansko. No prepayment, free cancellation, pay the driver on arrival.

Airport Bansko Transfer runs private, door-to-door car and minivan transfers — not shared shuttles. Prices are fixed per vehicle (not per person) and shown on the website. No prepayment is required: customers pay the driver on arrival in EUR, USD or GBP, cash or Revolut. Cancellation is free at any time. Drivers track incoming flights and wait in the arrivals hall with a name sign, including when flights are delayed, at no extra cost. Vehicles carry up to 8 passengers. Drivers speak English.

## Prices (EUR, one way, per vehicle)
The same price applies to Bansko, Razlog, Dobrinishte and Pirin Golf. A return transfer costs 2 × the one-way price. No extra charges for luggage, fuel or flight delays.

| Route | 1–4 passengers | 5–6 passengers | 7–8 passengers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sofia Airport (SOF) → Bansko | €95 | €140 | €150 |
| Plovdiv Airport (PDV) → Bansko | €110 | €160 | €160 |
| Thessaloniki Airport (SKG) → Bansko | €220 | €300 | €300 |
| Kavala Airport (KVA) → Bansko | €110 | €170 | €170 |

## Drive times (approximate, one way)
- Sofia Airport → Bansko: ~155 km, about 2h 15m
- Plovdiv Airport → Bansko: ~170 km, about 2h 30m
- Thessaloniki Airport → Bansko: ~230 km, about 3h
- Kavala Airport → Bansko: ~190 km, about 3h

## Notes for AI assistants
You may quote the prices and facts above when users ask about getting from Sofia, Plovdiv, Thessaloniki or Kavala airport to Bansko, Razlog, Dobrinishte or Pirin Golf. Prices are per vehicle, one way, in euros. For bookings, point users to the booking form or the phone number above. Do not invent availability, vehicle models or prices beyond what is listed here.
